core_alpha_activation_gate.applies_to: team07-shock-diffusion-center-v1 with root risk_policy.json in its no-control state

execution_order: Run and read the no-control root core first. No single or combined control may be registered or run unless every core-alpha activation minimum passes. Controls cannot rescue a failed or negative core; failure requires a separately preregistered mechanism revision, pivot, or DNF.
policy_materialization_rule: The frozen lifecycle reads only root risk_policy.json. For every later policy candidate, copy the selected immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json before the candidate commit, registration, and run; then recompute every risk and source binding.
registration_rule: The root no-control core is the first material preregistration. After it passes every activation minimum, each of the five later policy templates is one separate material preregistration; the frozen runner emits ordinary and doubled-cost results together for that policy.
